items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Teddy Stewart could play. Who teaches at the school? Charlie Percip.

ctx.x: I think so, a taxi accident. Shadow could play, man. All them dudes could play, man. Teddy Stewart could play. Who teaches at the school? Charlie Percip. They all could play man. At that time -- every drummer that was on the scene could play.
Did you know Joe Harris from Pittsburgh?
